en.hubeali:
From him, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ibn Sinana, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘As for what happens to be upon the gums, so swallow it and gobble it, and whatever was in between the teeth, so throw it’.
en.sarwar: 2. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from ibn Mahbub from ibn Sinan who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
What is in gingival (front gums) swallow it and what is between the other teeth throw it away.’”
